👤 About Me

I am a Master of IT in Business (Digital Transformation) candidate at Singapore Management University, with a background that bridges supply chain operations and data-driven decision-making. Before joining SMU, I spent several years managing procurement and logistics in Vietnam, where I developed a hands-on appreciation for how good data visualisation can cut through operational noise and drive meaningful action.

My journey into analytics began not in a classroom, but on the warehouse floor — building Excel models to track inventory, negotiating supplier contracts, and eventually integrating generative AI into reporting workflows. That practical foundation now informs how I approach every visualisation project in ISSS608: the goal is not a pretty chart, but a decision made with greater confidence.

Outside of coursework, I am currently interning at Singtel, where I work at the intersection of AI adoption, learning & development, and organisational transformation — helping teams understand and embed AI into their daily workflows.
